monitoring can outperform inspection as a pure maintenance strategy and that this result is robust against changes in the production settings.

(i) zero maintenance is the economically most efficient strategy at the margins of production perfection, (ii) monitoring outperforms the inspection as a pure maintenance strategy, and (iii) monitoring can be economically more self- evident than commonly assumed.
